root_cause.text: The io_import_fixed function in the io_uring rsrc subsystem fails to reject zero-length fixed buffer imports, causing the bvec skip logic to advance past the last bio_vec entry and read out-of-bounds slab memory.
root_cause.evidence: The CVE description states that io_import_fixed computes offset == imu->len when len is zero, causing the bvec skip logic to read bv_offset from out-of-bounds slab memory, and the patch adds an early return check for !len to prevent this logic execution.
